div.div: أَفَّافٌ A man who says أُفِّ much or often; (M, TA;) as also ↓ أُوفُوفَةٌ , accord. to the copies of the O and TS and K; but in other lexicons ↓ أُوفُوفَةٌ : in the O, one who ceases not to say to another أُفِّ لَكَ: in the Jm, the last of these three words is explained as meaning one who ceases no to say this at some of his affairs. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
